notes.title: Regenerate MoM

blocks.text:
Query for **deleting a MoM** so it can be regenerated.

> Replace `<YOUR_PROCESS_REF_NUM>` before running.

UPDATE process_data
SET data = data - 'f_15173'
WHERE process_reference_num = '<YOUR_PROCESS_REF_NUM>'
  AND activity_template_id = 751;

notes.title: Regenerate MoM

blocks.text:
Query for **deleting a MoM** so it can be regenerated.

> Replace `<YOUR_PROCESS_REF_NUM>` before running.

UPDATE process_data
SET data = data - 'f_15173'
WHERE process_reference_num = '<YOUR_PROCESS_REF_NUM>'
  AND activity_template_id = 751;
